text: Biggi Junior School is an ultra-modern junior school in Ndaba Village, Marama Parish, Panyimur Sub-County, Pakwach District — founded in 2022 out of a promise to give every child a chance to learn, regardless of what their family can afford. Today, we have over 200 registered pupils.
